about: An English soup post with 'for serving' and 'To garnish:' lines (the latter as the last ingredient line right before the method heading), prep and total time lines, a yield, cream that the method uses but the ingredient list never mentions, a tip that runs over two lines, and an introduction, call to action, mention and hashtags; a soup can reasonably be a main dish or a light meal. Written independently as a held-out case. Since 2026-11-01 a soup: the soups category (until then no category fit).

expect.title: Roasted Tomato & Red Pepper Soup

items: 2 red bell peppers, seeded and cut into strips
1 large red onion, cut into wedges

preparation: Spread the tomatoes, peppers, onion and garlic on a large tray, drizzle with the olive oil and sprinkle with the paprika, salt and pepper
Roast for 40 minutes, until the edges are charred and the tomatoes have collapsed
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins and tip everything into a large pot with the stock
Simmer for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth
Stir in the cream and warm through without letting it boil
Ladle into bowls and top with the basil
tips: the soup thickens in the fridge, so when reheating it the next day
add a splash of water or stock until it loosens up again
excluded: The first cold evening of the year calls for this soup
Roasting the vegetables first gives it a deep, almost smoky sweetness that you just don't get from simmering alone
If you make it, leave a comment and tell me what you dunked in it
